# 11 — The archer

*Written by the suite from [`tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd`](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd). Every line under **What the suite asserts** is the name of a test that runs on every pull request, and its link is the assertion.*

ADR-015's archer: it acts on balls leaving the course and on nothing else.

The archer inverts the usual defender test. For skeet the question is "does
it act when it should", and the failure mode that matters is acting unfairly.
Here the failure mode that matters is the opposite: an archer that acts on a
good shot is not a safety net, it is an ambush on the tutorial hole. So most
of what follows asserts that it does **nothing**.

## What the suite asserts

- [A shot down the fairway is ignored](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L53)
- [It does nothing across a whole spread of playable shots](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L60)
- [A ball leaving the course is shot](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L83)
- [The ball is pinned while it is still on the course](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L91)
- [The safety net does not fail](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L107)
- [It telegraphs like every other defender](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L119)
- [The action is to pin](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L141)
- [A bounds guard has no blind spot](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L145)

- [Watching holds the draw without committing](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L230)
- [It cannot act before it has registered the shot](../tests/defenders/test_archer_brain.gd#L246)
